query: Which retention strategies (incentives, tracing, re-consent, contact cadence) have evidence of maintaining >80% retention over 2–5 years in longitudinal studies of older adults in low-resource contexts?

response.query: Which retention strategies (incentives, tracing, re-consent, contact cadence) have evidence of maintaining >80% retention over 2–5 years in longitudinal studies of older adults in low-resource contexts?
response.answer: Incentives and frequent contact cadences have shown evidence of maintaining >80% retention over 2–5 years in longitudinal studies of older adults in low-resource contexts. Re-consent and tracing also help, but to a lesser extent.
